rows.label: HFHI's US advocacy cost booked in its US affiliates programme, FY2025 (US$)
rows.explainer: The Form 990 describes Habitat Voices in Action and HFHI's advocacy grants to affiliates under the US programme's heading (Part III line 4B; Schedule C: grants 'to support coalition building, grassroots building, and advocacy'), and the public awareness programme (line 4C) as media and events, so part of the advocacy's cost is in the US affiliates line. HFHI's whole lobbying spending was $877,000 (Schedule C); with policy staff, advocacy grants and campaign tools, about $2 million, range $1 million to $4 million. Taken out of the US model's cost and put in the awareness model's, so each counts it once.

rows.label: HFHI's Home Equals cost booked in its international programme, FY2025 (US$)
rows.explainer: The Form 990 reports Home Equals under 'Global impact' (line 4A, the international programme), so part of its cost (global policy staff, area offices' advocacy, campaign grants to national organisations) is in that line: about $1.5 million, range $0.5 million to $3 million. Taken out of the international model's cost and put in the awareness model's.
